pins.title: Weekend Getaways from Washington DC: Virginia's Northern Neck
pins.description: Weekend getaways from Washington DC, compared straight. Virginia's Northern Neck against the Eastern Shore: 2 hours 45 minutes, no Bay Bridge, and a sheltered tidal creek instead of open water.
pins.altText: A screened porch at Captain's Cottage looking west over a quiet tidal creek at golden hour.

pins.title: Weekend Trips from DC Without Bay Bridge Traffic
pins.description: Skip the Friday Bay Bridge backup. Weekend trips from DC to Virginia's Northern Neck run about 2 hours 45 minutes down I-95, with no bay crossing and no toll-bridge bottleneck.
pins.altText: Evening light going gold over a Northern Neck creek, seen from the dock.

pins.title: Where to Go Instead of the Eastern Shore: A DC Weekend
pins.description: Done St. Michaels? Virginia's Northern Neck is the quieter version of the same Chesapeake geography: sheltered water, fewer crowds, lower rates, and a shorter Friday drive from DC.
pins.altText: Two views of Chesapeake water: a screened porch over a calm creek, and a gold sunset from the dock.
